resources.string:
Full setup guide, PC client config and troubleshooting are on the GitHub Wiki: github.com/mjoohos23/Ejao/wiki
Short version: 1. START proxy - the app becomes a WiFi Direct hotspot. 2. Connect your PC/device to the SSID shown on screen. 3. On the PC point a SOCKS5 client like Proxifier at the socks5 address shown above (port 1080) - this gives systemwide TCP + UDP (games, DNS, UDP apps).
